answer: What survives to the summit is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, slashed on a failed audit, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Each submission hangs on the garden of a task receipt, and the zephyr is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short.
